mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.workspace_id, t.req_id, t.demand_id, t.title, t.board_column, t.progress, t.completed_at, t.category_id, t.due_date, t.start_date, t.updated_at, t.estimate_minutes, t.item_type AS itemType, t.owner, t.owner_user_id, t.branch_id AS branchId, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tl.minutes), 0) FROM time_log tl WHERE tl.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND tl.task_id = t.id AND tl.ended_at IS NOT NULL) AS total_minutes, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tl.minutes), 0) FROM time_log tl WHERE tl.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND tl.task_id = t.id AND tl.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND t.test_started_at IS NOT NULL AND t.test_finished_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(tl.started_at) BETWEEN DATE(t.test_started_at) AND DATE(t.test_finished_at)) AS test_minutes FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.req_id = #{reqId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY (t.board_column = 'done'), t.board_column, t.sort_order, t.id

SELECT t.id, t.workspace_id, t.req_id, t.demand_id, t.title, t.board_column, t.progress, t.completed_at, t.category_id, t.due_date, t.start_date, t.updated_at, t.estimate_minutes, t.item_type AS itemType, t.owner, t.owner_user_id, t.branch_id AS branchId, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tl.minutes), 0) FROM time_log tl WHERE tl.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND tl.task_id = t.id AND tl.ended_at IS NOT NULL) AS total_minutes, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tl.minutes), 0) FROM time_log tl WHERE tl.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND tl.task_id = t.id AND tl.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND t.test_started_at IS NOT NULL AND t.test_finished_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(tl.started_at) BETWEEN DATE(t.test_started_at) AND DATE(t.test_finished_at)) AS test_minutes FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.req_id = #{reqId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY (t.board_column = 'done'), t.completed_at, t.id

SELECT t.id, t.title, t.estimate_minutes FROM version_task vt INNER JOIN task t ON t.workspace_id = vt.workspace_id AND t.id = vt.task_id WHERE vt.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND vt.version_id = #{versionId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.id

SELECT vr.*, FROM version_release vr LEFT JOIN version_release_item i ON i.workspace_id = vr.workspace_id AND i.release_id = vr.id WHERE vr.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND vr.req_id = #{reqId} ORDER BY vr.occurred_at, vr.recorded_at, vr.id, i.id
SELECT version_id FROM version_task WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY version_id

SELECT vt.task_id AS taskId, vt.version_id AS versionId, pv.name AS versionName FROM version_task vt LEFT JOIN project_version pv ON pv.id = vt.version_id AND pv.workspace_id = vt.workspace_id WHERE vt.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND vt.task_id IN #{taskId} ORDER BY vt.task_id, vt.version_id
SELECT task_id AS taskId, version_id AS versionId FROM version_task WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY task_id, version_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM version_task WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND task_id = #{taskId}
